lxc_de80f090777f9e6b.text: Fast movement, careful jumps, and useful objects work together in this game.

lxc_220a701ac2ab3744.text: Start with the simple ideas, then explore the story of a famous classic.

lxc_c03fab3b66d89559.text: **Sonic the Hedgehog** is a fast platform game from 1991.

lxc_f07e8ba966395021.text: A platform game asks you to move and jump across places on the screen.

lxc_9711c1ba6a2c1a73.text: This means the view moves sideways as you travel through the level.

lxc_576ac9609d1aec3e.text: You control a blue hedgehog who runs at high speed.

lxc_6fc63641c10db422.text: You collect rings and try to stop **Doctor Robotnik**, the main enemy.

lxc_8951c1149013caec.text: **Doctor Eggman** is this enemy’s name in Japan.

lxc_0046ed07cf5296dd.text: The blue hedgehog is also the famous mascot of **Sega**, a Japanese video game company.

lxc_b82734c00b19fed3.text: A mascot is a character that represents a company.

lxc_ae45754018646114.text: You run and jump to move through the game.

lxc_6868b2d7beb9c47b.text: He curls into a ball and spins.

lxc_505eee8e7cca2fdf.text: He can roll into a ball on the ground, too.

lxc_29c6edc6c2f90fdc.text: This move is called a **Spin Attack**.

lxc_e24297d6ad038b94.text: The gold circles you collect are called **rings**.

lxc_6a8fd58d1b895731.text: When an enemy hits him, he drops his rings instead of losing a life.

lxc_2e00839761faa8c5.text: You can try to collect some again.

lxc_7652250403d86874.text: With no rings, getting hit by an enemy can cost him a life.

lxc_7d968bf963a1bef6.text: Speed helps, but rings matter too.

lxc_a89a12f42230441a.text: The game has different areas called zones.

lxc_92023bde77cc74a1.text: **Green Hill Zone** is the famous first level.

lxc_7ed8056fd8e7f770.text: It has green hills and loops.

lxc_020ae794a408aea3.text: A loop is a path that goes around in a circle.

lxc_dbe033675bd08eaf.text: Sonic can run through these loops at high speed.

lxc_dbe925288028669a.text: Later zones give you different places to explore.

lxc_d19fe26c3bfac6b9.text: At the end of many zones, you meet a boss.

lxc_faba874a90f00c99.text: A boss is a strong enemy in a special fight.

lxc_2dbe0e410c625a0d.text: You need to watch its movements and attack carefully.

lxc_9ff380a13a2c2cee.text: There are also **Chaos Emeralds**, special gems you can collect in special stages outside the main zones.

lxc_47dd993cf80fc076.text: **Sonic Team**, a game-making team at Sega, developed the original game.

lxc_70c05b1804518ec1.text: It came out for the **Sega Genesis**, a home game console.

lxc_036751279bc596af.text: **Mega Drive** is the console’s name outside North America.

lxc_81a9b67c7bcf9a02.text: The game arrived in North America and PAL regions, including Europe, in June 1991.

lxc_3392c38f4e4caa9e.text: It arrived in Japan on July 26, 1991.

lxc_6ec75be466b0c190.text: In the United States, Sega included the Genesis as pack-in with the console.

lxc_6b14586355084861.text: This pack-in copy helped many people start with Sonic.

lxc_70d3acf893d9e82a.text: Including those pack-in copies, it sold over 15 million copies on the Sega Genesis.

lxc_87dd6ea49ecdf054.text: This first game started a huge franchise, a family of related games and other products.

lxc_5863e6104ebe6334.text: The original 1991 game is the famous first classic at the center of Sonic’s story.

lxc_4b1593dbb0a64b2b.text: When people talk about classic Sonic, they often mean this game.

lxc_3f7441660143d2c4.text: Its first green level, gold rings, and fast movement are important parts of that picture.

lxc_78a1ff05ad86ae80.text: Rings give you a reason to look around and collect things.

lxc_ade726004341fda7.text: Hills and loops make the path more interesting than a straight road.

lxc_ee119924d5cde4bb.text: You do not only run as fast as possible.

lxc_f6e09e318144d467.text: You also choose when to jump, when to collect rings, and when to slow down.

lxc_f4ed1744af4a6399.text: Together, they became a large series.

lxc_70046c8c7d78167d.text: Sonic grew from the star of one game into a character known far beyond that first release.

lxc_cf79257037192e6f.text: Still, the 1991 original is the famous first flagship.

lxc_38a5dd54308bd153.text: A flagship is a leading product that helps people know a company.

lxc_121c910ffad9ff96.text: You do not need to know every later game to understand this classic.

lxc_00f7a3fdf0c888bb.text: Start with its main ideas: a blue hedgehog, fast movement, jumping, rings, and an enemy to stop.

lxc_43ce318669ee043a.text: That gives you a clear picture of where the series began.
